coordination_events.description: Consolidation pause-point: after 4 pause-ticks awaiting the operator, the (A)/(B) fork closed — operator chose GO THE DISTANCE (fully-general headline as the mission).
Main-checkout branch-leak recurred (a pen-and-paper artifact landed on the main checkout expedition/aoyagi-full); recovered, mitigation banked.
(2,2,2) interior-det cone-merge blocked by a cross-lineage seam; genm-detfderiv's branch had built green only because it forked an OLDER canonical (stale base).
D1 hchart crossed-handoff: controller misread genm-d1prod's budget-stop as permanent + spawned a duplicate; genm-d1hfin stood down at a clean boundary.
R1-LOWER eIn_projV0 thrash (mechanical combinator-apply, not new math) + rect-Schur pos/peel shard-division collision; fresh hand + Codex commissioned.
Background-agent worktree-spawn collision recurred ~3× on 06-30 (no work lost); root-caused with a recurrence fix + lesson (verify the main checkout after every isolation:worktree spawn).
Orchestrator crash mid-flight; clean controller pickup, zero work lost.
Operator PAUSE (rate-limiting): hands stood down, cron disarmed, work banked on branches.
RESUMED after the rate-limiting pause (idle days 07-04 / 07-05 had zero commits); disruption recorded, zero work lost.
Teammate touched the main checkout (2nd main-checkout incident); cleanly recovered, standing rule re-banked.
Build-contention lesson: scripts/lb global worker cap; hold to ≤2 heavy concurrent builds.
Crossed-handoff-duplicate lesson refined: base a fresh tide on the teammate's actual tip to avoid duplicate/racing work.
Branch-name collision (genm-seam clash); redirected the seam build to a fresh branch.
Concurrent-green-gate lesson: don't green-gate concurrently with an in-place teammate on the shared checkout.
